pr_body:
Today we react to a shard snapshot abort when processing that shard on a
`SNAPSHOT` thread, but those threads may be busy handling tasks related
to other shards for an extended period of time which delays the release
of the resources held by the shard snapshot tasks. With this commit we
fast-track the abort handling using the machinery introduced in #96426.

Closes #95316
pr_title: Release index commit promptly on snapshot abort

review_comment: It seems there could be a race condition involved around `closeException` in `SnapshotIndexCommit` in case `onAbort` and `onComplete` runs concurrently (as you pointed out, `decRef` might not have run before `onComplete` checks the `closeException`), the happens-before mentioned [here](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/96426/files#diff-35fe592a1471f816a2bea7eb7075fd0fa2a217cc31e8931055fd9a0cd81947efR50) is towards the `getAndSet` in `RunOnce`, where the `decRef` happens after that.
:+1: yes sorry for missing this earlier. #96571 will fix this up.
